d: A skeletal creature with a dark teal body, featuring a large, bony exoskeleton with ribbed plating across the torso and back. The head is a skull with glowing lime-green eyes, a protruding jaw, and a shock of dark blue hair styled in a swept-back pompadour. A small, pale-green ghostly face with glowing green eyes floats just above the main head. BODY COLOR: dark teal LEGS: plantigrade with wide, flat skeletal feet.
